accessibility.evidence: ui-smoke.json records zero automated WCAG A/AA violations across home, empty collection, reply, reveal, hello, shared/hidden cards, collection and sample reveal; keyboard focus containment/restoration and reduced motion checked. content-states scans loading, pause and offline states. Manual screen inspection supplements automation; no assistive-technology user study.

responsive.evidence: All browser captures assert document width <= viewport. Rendered mobile and desktop home/reveal/error states inspected for legibility, wrapping and order; mobile postcard precedes sharing/hello controls.

loading.evidence: content-states.json: held real WebSocket handshake at both target viewports; unavailable actions stay disabled.

empty.evidence: empty-360.png and empty-1440.png: new identity collection offers a working return to the writing flow.

error.evidence: error-360x800.png and error-1440x1000.png: authoritative owner pause rejects a valid submission; draft remains. Offline captures separately show editable text with disabled submission. Blocked-storage captures name the loss-of-reload guarantee while the draft and request metadata remain usable in the current tab.

partial.evidence: reveal-360.png: completed incoming postcard is usable while own outgoing setup is still waiting; live-return assertion later observes its arrival without refresh.

success.evidence: reveal-360.png and reveal-1440.png: real database-confirmed postcard, download and collection. Lost reply acknowledgment still reveals the server-confirmed card.

permission.evidence: shared-card-360.png shows no author hide control for a visitor; permission-360.png shows caller-only hiding after report; permission-1440.png shows unavailable permalink after actual author hiding. Private-table and owner-action checks in live-invariants.json.
